description: This file contains functions for checking relational integrity constraints between database tables in the Mattermost server, including specific checks for channels, commands, posts, schemes, sessions, teams, and users.

methods.name: getOrphanedRecords
methods.description: Retrieves orphaned records from the database based on the provided relational check configuration.

methods.name: checkParentChildIntegrity
methods.description: Performs an integrity check for a parent-child relationship using the specified configuration.

methods.name: checkChannelsCommandWebhooksIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for command webhooks related to channels.

methods.name: checkChannelsChannelMemberHistoryIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for channel member history records.

methods.name: checkChannelsChannelMembersIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for channel members.

methods.description: Checks integrity for incoming webhooks in channels.

methods.name: checkChannelsOutgoingWebhooksIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for outgoing webhooks in channels.

methods.name: checkChannelsPostsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for posts within channels.

methods.name: checkChannelsFileInfoIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for file info associated with channels.

methods.name: checkCommandsCommandWebhooksIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for command webhooks.

methods.name: checkPostsFileInfoIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for file info related to posts.

methods.name: checkPostsPostsRootIdIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for root post IDs in posts.

methods.name: checkPostsReactionsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for reactions on posts.

methods.name: checkSchemesChannelsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for channels within schemes.

methods.name: checkSchemesTeamsIntegrity

methods.name: checkSessionsAuditsIntegrity

methods.name: checkTeamsChannelsIntegrity

methods.name: checkTeamsCommandsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for commands within teams.

methods.name: checkTeamsIncomingWebhooksIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for incoming webhooks within teams.

methods.name: checkTeamsOutgoingWebhooksIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for outgoing webhooks within teams.

methods.name: checkTeamsTeamMembersIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for team members.
